title: Bootstrap observability stack for private clusters with Helm + Terraform automation
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Private installs currently require multiple manual steps to provision observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki/Fluentd) and to wire Alertmanager and dashboards into customer VPCs. This PR adds an idempotent, operator-like bootstrap flow that ties a small Terraform module to Helm releases so observability can be created, upgraded, or rolled back as part of an install/upgrade pipeline. Changes include: a terraform module that provisions DNS records, optional ALB/ingress resources and TLS secrets (KMS-encrypted), Helm umbrella chart and value overlays for Prometheus/Grafana/Loki, provisioning of Grafana dashboards via the config provider, out-of-band Alertmanager template and receiver manifests for common SLO alerts, a bootstrap script that performs readiness checks and can run in CI, and post-install hooks that implement safe rollback behavior. The desired outcome is a single command (redwoodctl observability apply) during private install that results in a fully configured observability stack with minimal manual intervention. Checklist: - Terraform module: modules/observability (DNS, optional ALB, kms-wrapped secrets, outputs for endpoints) - Helm umbrella chart: charts/observability (prometheus-operator, grafana, loki, fluent-bit) - Grafana provisioning: dashboards/provisioning + example dashboards for token-cost and per-route latency - Alerting: alertmanager/templates and default receivers for PagerDuty/Slack - Bootstrap CLI: scripts/bootstrap-observability.sh and redwoodctl wrapper with idempotent apply/destroy and health-checks - Upgrade/rollback: helm hooks and Terraform state migration notes in docs - Docs: docs/private/observability-automation.md Tests and validation: helm lint, terraform validate, k8s manifests dry-run, and lightweight e2e that deploys to a test kube cluster in CI.

ci_logs_summary: Initial CI run failed on terraform validate due to a provider version pin; fixed by updating provider constraints. Helm lint flagged deprecated apiVersion for Deployment in grafana templates; resolved by switching to apps/v1 and adding minimal selectors. Final CI run: terraform validate OK, helm lint OK, unit tests OK, lightweight e2e completed against a kind cluster; total CI time ~42m.
release_notes: Added automated observability bootstrap for private installs. New terraform module and umbrella Helm chart allow one-command provisioning of Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and log collectors. Grafana dashboards and Alertmanager defaults included. Feature gated behind 'observability.enabled' flag; no breaking changes by default.
additional_notes: This PR intentionally keeps observability optional for minimal-footprint customers. The bootstrap script supports dry-run and --force flags. Ops teams should review KMS key policies before enabling automated secret creation. Future follow-ups planned: role-based dashboard provisioning, multi-tenant Alertmanager routing, and integration tests against our Dedicated environment templates.
